title: Courtyard that is the only daylight source to a habitable room is uncovered and at least 4 m2 (R30-R60)
text: Where a courtyard is the only source of daylight to a habitable room, the courtyard must be uncovered and open to the sky¹ with a: i. minimum area of 4m2 (refer Figure 2.2a). ¹Excludes minor projections

replaces.note: (ii) minimum dimension 0.5 x wall height for multiple dwellings dropped from the clause; Figure 2.2a still shows it
habitable room openable window, 10% of floor area, 50% transparent; no successor (NCC), register C4P1-035
bathroom openable window; no successor (NCC), register C4P1-036

notes: from: ch3 C2.2.1 (evaluator unchanged). Coding R30-R60 per the 'Windows and openings (applies to R30-R60 only)' heading. Register C4P1-034: Figure 2.2a still annotates 'Min dimension = 0.5 x wall height', so the dropped limb (ii) is likely a drafting omission; not encoded. Open to the sky excludes minor projections (footnote 1). The deleted window and bathroom ventilation clauses have no rule.
